results.title: Hema
results.overview: Having recently arrived in America with her husband and son, Hema finds herself culturally displaced and must redefine her identity as a dependent mother. An encounter with a young Marathi man threatens to upend her already fragile existence.

results.title: A Joke
results.overview: Xiao Mei and Xiao Shuai turn their marriage bed into a battleground. The two formidable rivals bring all they know to the game, locked in a romantic contest. As their emotional tug-of-war unfolds to a final reckoning, both come face to face with their true selves.

results.title: Strange Tales of Bangjia Town
results.overview: In the early years of the Republic of China era, there are multiple cases of the Clam God killing people in Bangjia Town. The provincial police send Ji Hechuan and a team to investigate, and they acquire the help of Cheng Yueyao, who does not believe in the Clam God curse. They learn from a local, Xiu, that a ghost marriage with Young Master Cheng, who is said to be the reincarnation of the Clam God, fell through, because the bride Lu Mingyue escaped seven days ago. The Clam God is enraged...

results.title: The Pool
results.overview: About a guy navigating through midlife crisis, depression, being still in love with his ex wife and his relationship with his son, all while trying to find meaning in life in general.

results.title: Glasses
results.overview: A group of people come together to test an exciting and experimental new technology. But it quickly turns into a deadly game of survival as the technology turns against them.

results.title: História de Música: "São São Paulo Meu Amor"
results.original_title: História de Música: "São São Paulo Meu Amor"
results.overview: In 1968, Tom Zé moved from Bahia to São Paulo, went to the movies, had lunch with Caetano Veloso, and one morning composed the song that would go on to win the main music festival on Brazilian television that year. In "História de Música", the most São Paulo–minded of Bahian artists tells how filmmaker Luiz Sérgio Person introduced him to the paulista capital at one of the city's most famous intersections.

results.title: spilled milk
results.overview: When faced with the haunting memories of her complicated relationship with Mark, Kate is forced to decipher if what she believes happened between them is reality.

results.title: Where Dreams Sleep
results.overview: A man plunged into grief connects through his dreams with the love he lost in a car accident.

results.title: A Year in London
results.overview: A sheltered Italian fashion student in London for the first time forms a intense, intimate bond with her brilliant mentor after they survive a violent robbery—forcing them to choose between ambition, boundaries, and the love they’re afraid to name.

results.title: Foka
results.overview: Dr. Dimitri Foka, a Greek doctor from Turkey, survives a Nazi execution in Greece during World War II thanks to his Turkish passport. After graduating, he returns to his hometown, the island of Imroz (Gökçeada), part of Turkey, and becomes the island’s only doctor for many years. Following the Cyprus problem in 1964, state policies targeting the Greek population lead to dispossession, violence, and forced migration on the island, yet Foka refuses to leave.

results.title: Many Waters
results.overview: Natali, a beautiful Israeli model, is paralyzed after an accident at sea. While at rehabilitation she meets Yossef, a kind Palestinian paraprofessional. Albeit her being suspicious at the start the two fall in love. When their relationship is discovered, the reservations coming from their families threaten to separate them.

results.title: The Blow
results.overview: Nineteen-year-old Enzo and his twenty-year-old sister Carla have been left to fend for themselves for several years. When their father, Anthony, is released from prison, Enzo sees the fragile promise of a family to rebuild, unlike Carla, for whom the idea remains inconceivable. Haunted by his past, Enzo must confront a truth he has kept hidden for far too long.

results.title: The Room Below
results.overview: After losing her son to cancer, a grieving mother living with a mysterious creature in her home befriends another boy to replace her dead son. But when a retired detective begins investigating the child's disappearance, her carefully constructed world starts to unravel.

results.title: Holidays
results.overview: Eleven-year-old Fridolin lives far away, with his mother. That’s why he only sees his father, Jan, during the holidays – which Frido looks forward to like crazy. His adventurous dad always comes up with loads to do – after all, he’s the best dad in the world! But unfortunately, Jan has a serious drinking problem...

results.title: Gail
results.overview: A superfan of the Canadian band Our Lady Peace follows them on their 30th anniversary tour across Canada.
